description: This file defines the WallFriends class, which is part of the Goteo project. It is responsible for managing and rendering a widget that displays avatars and investment information of project investors, including functions for processing avatar data, generating HTML content, and styling the widget.

classes.name: WallFriends
classes.description: A class that manages and renders a visual widget displaying supporters’ avatars and investment info related to a specific project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with project investors and avatar sizing parameters.

methods.name: pondera
methods.description: Static method to weigh the investments and normalize avatar sizes between 1 and a maximum multiplier.

methods.name: html_content
methods.description: Generates an array of HTML snippets containing avatars and layout divs for display in the widget.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Creates styled HTML output including the avatars, project info, and supporting details, optionally opening links in new tabs.
